name: cmux.sidebar.rows/1
docs: Decorations of the sidebar's workspace rows (honored from the user's own local/customize app only). The render export returns one Group per decorated row with props {row, icon?, weight?, indicator?, badge?}: icon is an SF Symbol name or one emoji; weight is regular, medium, semibold or bold; indicator is default, none, an indicator style, "glyph" (the look's agentPane.display.thinking.glyph played while the row works) or {choreography, trigger?}: a cmux.particles/1 document (or "glyph") played in the loading indicator's place while the row works, with the trigger to play (an acpmux tool kind or session state; checked like a Particles node's choreography); badge is short text. Rows without a Group keep the defaults (no icon, regular weight).
status: draft: shapes are refined with the first implementing app before the interface is public
